data.name: Taranveer
data.gender_notes: Taranveer is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Taranveer is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Taran' which means 'to save, deliver' and 'Veer' which means 'brave, hero'. This name is often given to a boy who is expected to overcome adversities and bring victory in various aspects of life. The name Taranveer carries the meaning “Victory, Overcoming Obstacles” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Taranveer usually hope their child will grow to embody victory, overcoming obstacles and live with faith, good character and purpose.
